capabilities: Expose cursor movement commands (up, down, left, right, page, line ends)
Expose cursor selection commands for directional selection
Leave shortcut binding to the user via Hotkeys settings
extras: No commands ship with default keybindings; the README only recommends a hjkl-like Alt/Ctrl+letter scheme.
problem: Obsidian provides no default shortcuts for fine-grained cursor movement and selection, so users must define their own navigation commands.
summary: Cursor navigation plugin that exposes cursor movement and selection commands for custom hotkey bindings in the editor.
